strongest_angle: Claude Sonnet 5.5 vs Kimi K3: A Detailed Model Comparison

key_facts.fact: Claude Sonnet 5.5 outperforms Kimi K3 by a margin of 81.84 to 69.34 in overall benchmark scores, indicating superior accuracy and efficiency.
Kimi K3 leads Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the aggregate score, achieving a 101.9 to 99.0 lead, highlighting its superior performance in certain benchmarks.
Kimi K3 costs 50% more per input token than Claude Sonnet 5.5, with a larger context window of 1,048,576 tokens compared to Claude Sonnet 5.5's 1,000,000 tokens.
